_doc: Untried-execution-block audit of every failed target-band in the ALMA 20-40 pc technosignature survey. Question asked: how many of the failures have public execution blocks that the pipeline never tried, and do those blocks carry calibration products? Method: the survey's own per-target process logs for what was tried, ALMA datalink (Alma.get_data_info, expand_tarfiles=True) for the full list of raw ASDM progenitors and for the *contents* of each delivered tarball, and ivoa.obscore for array configuration, field names and pointing centres. expand_tarfiles=True reads the tar index from archive metadata, so per-block calibration products are established without downloading anything. No ALMA data was downloaded and none was processed.

_snapshot.note: The brief says 69 failures; the live summary at snapshot time records 68. A pass-3 driver was actively re-attempting failed targets on the host during this audit, so the count moves. The 68 audited here are the rc != 0 entries in the snapshot above.
_snapshot.eb_order_assumption: calibrate_generic.py keeps asdm_files[:3] in datalink order. Verified against the logs: in 157 of 157 attempts where the log names any execution block, the named blocks are a subset of the first three in datalink order.
